newsitem.title: UK: Go-Ahead to buy bus firm Brighton Transport.
newsitem.headline: Go-Ahead to buy bus firm Brighton Transport.

text.p: UK rail and bus operator Go-Ahead Group Plc said on Monday it had agreed to buy Brighton Transport Ltd for around 5.76 million stg.
The deal is for 180p in cash for each Brighton Transport share, although shareholders can elect to receive 0.3838 of a new Go-Ahead ordinary share for each Brighton Transport share.
It has received irreovocable undertakings representing 14.34 percent of Brighton's issued share capital to accept the offer.
Brighton Transport operates local bus services within Brighton and Hove and throughout mid Sussex in southern England.
